verdict.rationale: Alloy is a SaaS identity and fraud-decisioning platform, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers public docs, an OpenAPI spec and an SDK reference, but nothing shows the product's source code published under an open license. Public API documentation is an adjacent openness feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
